text:
Sophie (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring & org changes. We know folks will have questions about transfers, timelines, and how this impacts ongoing projects. Putting answers here so managers can point folks to it.

Andre (People Ops): TL;DR: 36 net-new roles across the company over 12 months. Internal transfer window opens today for 10 business days. We will prioritize internal moves where skills align.

Zoe (Hiring Manager): Can you confirm how many IC roles for runtime vs infra? Also curious if any roles are contractor/temporary.

Marta (VP Eng): Breakdown for Eng: runtime 7, infra 5, ml infra 3, sre 3. No planned contractor hires for core runtime - all FTEs. We will use contractors for short-term tooling or doc sprints only.

Kai (Senior PM): Product hires are mostly PMs for Dedicated/Private and a growth PM for onboarding. Are there plans to hire TPMs to help with cross-team rollouts?

Sophie (CEO): We'll add 1 TPM focused on major cross-functional rollout coordination (Q3).

Jun (Staff SWE): If I put in an internal transfer request, what happens to my current team's velocity? Is there backfill support?

Andre (People Ops): Managers: please plan for backfills. People Ops will work with hiring managers to prioritize critical backfills; team leads get a heads-up when transfers are approved.

Ava (Recruiter): Interview flow reminder: 1) 30m phone screen 2) practical exercise (runtime roles get a perf/kernel task) 3) onsite loop. Internal transfers may skip stages if hiring manager confirms strong fit.

Jun (Staff SWE): Oncall anxiety: runtime team members worry about additional rollout burden. Any mitigation planned?

Marta (VP Eng): Were introducing a Resilience Owner per squad, shifting some production ops into Dedicated oncall rotations, and funding runbook automation. Goal: reduce peak oncall incidents by ~20% after hires and automation.

Zoe (Hiring Manager): What about promotions & banding for transfers? Will people be re-banded automatically?

Andre (People Ops): Transfers don't auto-change band. Promotions follow our normal cadence. If a transfer is into a materially different role/level, comp approvals will be handled case-by-case; managers should flag required approvals early.

Kai (Senior PM): Any org-wide reporting changes? Managers are asking about new OKRs tied to these hires.

Sophie (CEO): We'll update the company OKRs to reflect Dedicated & Private targets. Expect team-level OKR guidance from Product and Eng leads next week.

OrgBot: Internal links: headcount ledger: https://redwood.example.com/internal/headcount; transfer form: https://redwood.example.com/internal/transfer-form; org sketch: https://redwood.example.com/internal/org-sketch

Ava (Recruiter): I'll post role-by-role hiring timelines and interview prep in #devex. PMs and Eng leads: please review your opening descriptions by EOD Friday.

Sophie (CEO): Thanks. If you have payroll/relocation questions DM @Andre. We'll publish an FAQ doc and a public timeline (internal) by EOD tomorrow. :sparkles:
